sentences.text: No; for a Tier 3 UCB, a pre-payment charge is not permitted on a floating-rate business loan to an MSE with sanctioned amount up to ₹50 lakh, and this case meets those conditions. [E3, E6]
The earlier RBI pre-payment-charge directions for floating-rate loans were superseded, so the in-force rule here is the 2025 UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions. [E17, E18, E1, E3]
